targets.queryText: SELECT value AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'input_run_id'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT value AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'input_run_id'

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(0, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER)) AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'generated_utc'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(0, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER)) AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'generated_utc'

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN 'STOPPED OR STALE' WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) <= 5 THEN 'LIVE' WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) <= 30 THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'STOPPED OR STALE' END AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'generated_utc'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN 'STOPPED OR STALE' WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) <= 5 THEN 'LIVE' WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) <= 30 THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'STOPPED OR STALE' END AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'generated_utc'

targets.queryText: SELECT value AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'input_snapshot_sequence'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT value AS value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key = 'input_snapshot_sequence'

panels.description: This shows the network-isolated shadow path only. A stale status means the dashboard has stopped receiving coherent causal snapshots; inspect the collector's terminal summary and readiness telemetry for source-specific diagnosis.

targets.queryText: SELECT key AS 'Field', value AS 'Value' FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key IN ('input_run_id', 'input_snapshot_sequence', 'generated_utc', 'schema_version', 'pnl_basis') ORDER BY CASE key WHEN 'input_run_id' THEN 1 WHEN 'input_snapshot_sequence' THEN 2 WHEN 'generated_utc' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT key AS 'Field', value AS 'Value' FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key IN ('input_run_id', 'input_snapshot_sequence', 'generated_utc', 'schema_version', 'pnl_basis') ORDER BY CASE key WHEN 'input_run_id' THEN 1 WHEN 'input_snapshot_sequence' THEN 2 WHEN 'generated_utc' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Shadow Pipeline Metadata

targets.queryText: SELECT event_utc AS 'UTC', run_id AS 'Run', scenario_id AS 'Scenario', event_type AS 'Event', COALESCE(action, '') AS 'Action', COALESCE(reason, '') AS 'Reason', COALESCE(market_ticker, '') AS 'Market' FROM shadow_events ORDER BY event_utc DESC, event_sequence DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT event_utc AS 'UTC', run_id AS 'Run', scenario_id AS 'Scenario', event_type AS 'Event', COALESCE(action, '') AS 'Action', COALESCE(reason, '') AS 'Reason', COALESCE(market_ticker, '') AS 'Market' FROM shadow_events ORDER BY event_utc DESC, event_sequence DESC LIMIT 100
